sub: What the Jutyar farmer app reads from the server when it opens: the oldest version allowed, maintenance, an announcement, feature switches and limits. A change reaches the app without a new release.
reads_note: The app reads these settings when it opens.
no_versions: No farmer has opened the app in the last 30 days.
v_order: The oldest allowed version cannot be newer than the newest version.
maint_on_sub: The app shows the message and works offline only.
f_add_farm_sub: Walk the corners and paint the crops
f_doctor_sub: Needs the Doctor service on the server
f_reports_sub: Send a report from the field
ann_on_sub: At the top of the app's home screen
l_positive: Every limit must be more than 0.
l_corners: The fewest corners cannot be more than the most corners.
help_phone_sub: Farmers call it from the app
public_totals: Farm totals on the public page
public_totals_sub: Farmers, farms and dunam, no names or phones
stale: Someone else saved these settings since you opened the page. The form now shows their version: check it and save again.
